label: copy phase of length-3 sequences (strongest on final output)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original tokens or the <DEL> step). Its core is length-3 sequences: on L=3 copy steps (t=4,5) it is active 80% of the time, and on the final L=3 step (t=5, outputting orig(2), input orig(1)) it is active 99.5% of the time. That step carries about half of all activation mass and all of the top activations, which reach ~1.0 of max; t=4 activations are weak (~0.1-0.2). The remaining ~38% of mass is a diffuse, low-magnitude tail (mostly <0.5 of max) on other copy steps, concentrated near the end of the copy (to_go <= 1; 92% of mass) and on L=4 recall_idx 2, with mild preference for inputs j/y/i/v/3. No token rule captures that tail. Does not fire in the original or delimiter phases.
